# Historical Nobel Prize Cohort Demonstration

*Preserved from original `Juselius_secretdoor` codebase.*
Demonstrated that the underlying network construction algorithms could be repurposed from Jusélius grantees to arbitrary cohorts (such as Nobel Laureates in Physiology or Medicine).

In the refactored EKFS-DFG platform, this cohort concept has been formally abstracted into the unified cohort specification engine (`config/config.yaml` and `R/normalise_entities.R`).
